protocol.models: Original pinned TensorFlow variables only. No checkpoint update or numerical tolerance change.
protocol.comparisons: Callable vs frozen TensorFlow; frozen vs exposed TF; optimized and unoptimized ONNX, ordinary and intermediate-exposed. Exact-name, same-shape intermediate comparison, layout mismatch explicitly unavailable.
protocol.observation_effect: Exposing outputs may change backend fusion. Compare observed and regular final outputs separately; do not infer unobserved parity from an observed pass.
protocol.resources: Existing GitHub CPU only. Fifteen-minute process, twenty-minute job. At most256 observed tensors and20M scalar values per backend per synthetic case. Small report collected once; graph and intermediate arrays stay remote.
protocol.acceptance: Numerical localization only. No model, pitch, timing, corpus or live acceptance claim.
